Subject: Claim Decision Regarding Your Theft Claim

Dear {CLAIMANT_NAME},

We have completed the review of your claim regarding the theft that occurred on 2026-04-12. We are pleased to inform you that your claim has been approved.

The loss is covered under your comprehensive coverage. According to your policy, [COMP-1] "We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto not caused by collision, minus the comprehensive deductible shown in the Declarations."

The net payment to you is {PAYOUT}. Please note that the {DEDUCTIBLE} has already been subtracted from this amount.

As a next step, payment of {PAYOUT} will be issued within 5 business days.

If you have any questions regarding this decision, please contact us at our claims department.

ClaimPilot Claims Team
